raw_record.question_text: $\overline{AD}$ and $\overline{CG}$ are diameters of $\odot B$. Find $m\widehat{ACF}$.

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: a circle centered at B has vertical diameter C-B-G and slanted diameter A-B-D. Point F lies on the lower-right arc between D and G. The image labels central angle ∠CBD as 55° and central angle ∠GBF as 35°. From the text, AD and CG are diameters, so arcs ACD and CDG are semicircles of 180°. Convert the labeled central angles to arc measures: arc CD = 55° and arc GF = 35°. Since A-D is a diameter, arc AC + arc CD = 180°, giving arc AC = 125°. Since C-G is a diameter along the right side, arc CD + arc DF + arc FG = 180°, giving arc DF = 180 - 55 - 35 = 90°. Then add the arcs along arc ACF: arc AC + arc CD + arc DF = 125 + 55 + 90 = 270°.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：附图显示一个以 B 为圆心的圆。C 在圆的上方，G 在圆的下方，C-B-G 是一条竖直直径；A 在左下方，D 在右上方，A-B-D 是另一条斜直径。F 位于右下方的圆周上。图中标出中心角 ∠CBD = 55°，以及中心角 ∠GBF = 35°。

推理：中心角的度数等于所对弧的度数，所以弧 CD = 55°，弧 GF = 35°。因为 AD 是直径，所以从 A 到 D 经过 C 的半圆弧 ACD 为 180°，因此弧 AC = 180° - 55° = 125°。因为 CG 是直径，所以从 C 到 G 经过 D、F 的右半圆弧 CD + DF + FG = 180°，因此弧 DF = 180° - 55° - 35° = 90°。要求 m弧 ACF，即从 A 到 F 且经过 C 的弧，所以 m弧 ACF = 弧 AC + 弧 CD + 弧 DF = 125° + 55° + 90° = 270°。
